title: Monster matinee
blurb: Godzilla, Gamera and every rubber-suited monster Tokyo could build, plus Santo, the silver-masked wrestler who fought all of them and more.

films.note: Godzilla goes to space to fight King Ghidorah.
Santo, the silver-masked wrestler, against Frankenstein's daughter.
The 1954 Godzilla, recut and coloured in Italy in 1977. Fans call it Cozzilla.
Shochiku's monster: a space chicken, more or less.
Gappa, from Nikkatsu, the only giant monster film that studio made.
Japan's first colour science fiction film, with giant starfish aliens.
Gamera's first film, cut up and dubbed for American television.
